newsArray.title: SA vs AUS: Steve Smith cleared of concussion after helmet blow, returns to field in Durban Test
newsArray.description: Steve Smith was struck by a delivery during Australia's second innings and subsequently passed concussion tests. After not fielding during South Africa’s innings on Day 4, he returned to help his team on the final day. Smith took a catch to dismiss Kyle Verreynne and boosted Australia's chances of victory. South Africa resumed their chase needing 319 runs but two wickets by lunch. The second Test of the series is set to begin on Sunday.
creator: hijam raju singh

newsArray.title: Assam: CM Sarma inaugurates Naharkatia Multi Sports Complex to strengthen sports infrastructure
newsArray.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Tuesday inaugurated the Naharkatia Multi Sports Complex marking an addition to Assams sports infrastructure The Complex is the first of its kind in the Naharkatia Legislative Assembly Constituency and the facility has been developed to promote sporting activities and provide modern infrastructure for training competitions and recreational activities

newsArray.title: Naharkatiya Unveils New Multi-Sports Complex to Foster Local Talent
newsArray.description: The recent inauguration of a Rs 22-crore multi-sports complex in Naharkatiya marks a significant development for local athletes. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma emphasized the importance of this facility in providing a platform for youth to showcase their talents. The complex features state-of-the-art facilities, including a football ground, athletics track, and swimming pool. Sarma also highlighted ongoing efforts to enhance sports infrastructure in the region, including a new cricket ground and hockey stadium. He encouraged local youth to participate in the upcoming Khel Maharan event, aimed at identifying emerging talent and promoting sports participation. This initiative reflects the government's commitment to nurturing sporting potential in Naharkatiya.
creator: narendra chaudhary
